intro.greeting: Hello Friends and Members of Chorlton Bikes,
paragraphs: We're really glad you're here. This newsletter is a chance to share what we've been up to - our riders, our partners, and the difference we're making together in Chorlton and beyond.

October has been a month of partnerships old and new - from prison ROTL visits and NHS evening collections to Women in Cycling, trail barriers, Bikes4Refugees and our website relaunch. Here's what we've been up to.

monthIntro: From HMP Kirkham and NHS extended hours to Women in Cycling, our AGM date, Transpennine Trail barriers, Bikes4Refugees and a website glow-up - plus Emmeline's Elves in November - October has been full of community momentum.

sections.title: Visit to HMP Kirkham
bullets: 🔐 On Wednesday 7th October, Tom visited HMP Kirkham to learn more about ROTL (Release on Temporary Licence) schemes - pathways into employment for people nearing the end of their sentence through paid and unpaid work placements.
🔐 A salutary statistic from the day: 1 in 4 adults of working age have a criminal record - a significant section of society, and rehabilitative work chimes strongly with our values at Chorlton Bikes.
🔐 We are exploring how this could work with Dave Nicholson and the Brewcycle group, who have a project based at St Margaret's Playing Fields.

images.alt: Visit to HMP Kirkham to learn about ROTL schemes
Brewcycle project at St Margaret's Playing Fields

sections.title: NHS extended hours collections
bullets: 🏥 We are delighted to be supporting our partner surgeries with collections for their extended hours during weekday evenings and at weekends.
🏥 We have built strong working relationships with these surgeries over a number of years - collecting samples and delivering them to pathology labs.
🏥 We always strive to strengthen and extend this partnership whenever we can.

images.alt: NHS England logo - extended hours collections partnership

sections.title: Women in Cycling - Anna
bullets: 🚴 On Friday 2nd October, Anna attended Women in Cycling at Stretford Public Hall.
🚴 It was a lovely morning meeting other women-led cycling groups, discussing the challenges we face and brainstorming solutions together.

images.alt: Anna at Women in Cycling at Stretford Public Hall

sections.title: AGM and election
bullets: 📅 Another plug for our AGM / Open Social on 25th November at Dulcimer Bar in Chorlton, 7pm–9pm.
📅 We will share our experiences in 2026 and look ahead to what the future holds for Chorlton Bikes.
📅 We will be there from 6pm if anyone would like to talk to our directors about Chorlton Bikes and how to get involved.
📅 There will be light refreshments available, and the bar at Dulcimer for drinks.

cta.label: Interested in becoming a director? Get in touch

images.alt: Chorlton Bikes AGM and Open Social at Dulcimer Bar

sections.title: Walk Wheel Cycle Trust - Transpennine Trail barriers
bullets: 🛤️ We were recently contacted by Walk Wheel Cycle Trust (formerly Sustrans) to support their campaign to remove barriers from the Transpennine Trail, after successfully removing some from the Fallowfield Loop.
🛤️ These barriers often impede cargo bikes - and we have had feedback from local families who would like to use these routes on school runs.
🛤️ We have written in support of their campaign and are broadly supportive of anything that enables more families to cycle to school and work.

images.alt: Walk Wheel Cycle Trust campaign to remove Transpennine Trail barriers

sections.title: Bikes4Refugees
bullets: 🚲 We continue to collect pre-loved bikes for the charity Bikes 4 Refugees.
🚲 Our amazing mechanic Dave refurbishes these bikes at a phenomenal rate, and we also help transport bikes between refurbishment and allocation.
🚲 Please note: we cannot allocate refurbished bikes straight to refugees or others in need. For allocation, contact info@rainbowhaven.org.uk.
🚲 We nominated both Dave and Lucy (whose energy drives the whole initiative) for a Best of Manchester award - because that is exactly what they are.
🚲 If you have a pre-loved bike you would like to donate, please get in touch.

cta.label: Donate a pre-loved bike - get in touch

images.alt: Bikes 4 Refugees bike collection and refurbishment

sections.title: Website glow-up!
bullets: ✨ One of our incredible directors, Ben, has revamped and relaunched our website - chorltonbikes.coop - with a new look and some new features.
✨ We're so grateful to have volunteer members and directors like Ben who offer their skills to keep our community moving forward.
✨ We're especially looking for help with mechanics, accountancy, grant-funding, graphic design and videography - if you have a skill to offer, please get in touch.

cta.label: Offer a skill or get in touch

sections.title: Emmeline's Elves - Sunday 29th November, 10am–1pm
bullets: 🎅 Our crack team of biking Elves will be out on their e-cargo sleighs on Sunday 29th November, 10am–1pm!

🎅 We are looking for donations of new toys, books, gift sets, chocolates/cakes/selection boxes or new pyjamas to help our friends at Emmeline's Pantry, who support families who have experienced domestic violence and food insecurity.
🎅 Please email us with what you would like to contribute and your address - and we will scramble the Elves to your door on the 29th!

cta.label: Donate for Emmeline's Elves - email us

images.alt: Emmeline's Elves e-cargo bike toy collection

paragraphs: Thank you to everyone for the continued energy, care and commitment that keeps Chorlton Bikes moving forward - from ROTL conversations and NHS runs to Women in Cycling, trail campaigns and festive Elves.
Whether you're riding, volunteering, donating, or simply spreading the word, you're helping us build a stronger and more connected community. See you at the AGM on 25th November! 🚲💚
